title: Single-flight Token Refresh and Concurrent 401s Check

questions.prompt: What should twenty concurrent 401s for one token generation trigger?
questions.explanation: Single-flight prevents refresh storms and rotating-token races.

questions.prompt: Every HTTP 401 should be retried forever after refreshing.
questions.explanation: Refresh and replay are bounded and only appropriate for a stale refreshable credential.

questions.answer: To detect that another caller already refreshed
questions.explanation: Waiters can reuse newer state instead of starting redundant work.
